dra.bio.texto-1: I hold a degree in Dentistry, I specialised in orthodontics, and I have spent over 25 years working exclusively in orthodontics.
dra.bio.texto-2: I hold the top provider tier in invisible orthodontics for the number of cases successfully completed. It recognises the volume of treatments finished; every case is assessed individually and no clinical result can be guaranteed in advance.
dra.bio.texto-3: I run Sonris in Sanchinarro, where we only do invisible orthodontics.
dra.bio.titulo: My whole career in a single speciality
dra.casos.1.descripcion: The teeth were overlapping and rotated, with no room in the arch. By the end, every tooth sits in its place and the contacts are even.
dra.casos.2.descripcion: A gap between the upper incisors and a bite that covered the lower ones. I closed the space and brought the overlap back to its proper height.
dra.casos.3.descripcion: The front teeth did not meet when biting. Now they touch, which is what lets you bite through food with them.
dra.casos.4.descripcion: The upper teeth almost completely covered the lower ones. I opened the bite until the lower teeth were visible.
dra.casos.5.descripcion: Lower crowding, a deep bite and teeth in crossbite, all three at once. They were corrected in the same treatment.
dra.casos.nota: Cases published with each patient's signed consent.
dra.docencia.texto-1: I give national and international lectures to doctors from all over the world. When other orthodontists want to learn how to handle difficult cases with aligners, they listen to me.
dra.docencia.texto-2: For you, that means one practical thing: the judgement I use to assess your case is the same one I teach in those lecture halls.

legal.politica-de-cookies.1.titulo: This website does not use its own cookies

legal.politica-de-privacidad.1.punto-2: Your clinical record, if you are treated with us: reason for consultation, tests, images, treatment plan and progress.

legal.politica-de-privacidad.2.parrafo-2: This transfer is covered by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.2.parrafo-3: The channel you choose —WhatsApp or email— tells us how to reply; if we write to you on WhatsApp, that conversation goes through WhatsApp Ireland Limited (Meta group), which applies its own privacy policy.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.3.punto-1: Handling your request and contacting you: because you ask us to.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.3.punto-2: Treating you and keeping your clinical record: because healthcare and the law that regulates it (Ley 41/2002) require it. Health data is processed under Article 9(2)(h) of the GDPR (RGPD), which allows it to be used for diagnosis and care.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.3.punto-3: Invoicing and keeping accounts: because the law requires us to.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.3.punto-4: Reminding you of an appointment or a check-up: because it is part of your treatment.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.3.punto-5: Sending you marketing information: only if you give us permission, and you can withdraw it whenever you like.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.4.punto-1: Enquiries that do not lead to an appointment: one year from the last contact.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.4.punto-2: Clinical record: at least five years from the discharge of each treatment, as required by Ley 41/2002.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.4.punto-3: Invoices and accounts: between four and six years, depending on tax and commercial law.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.4.punto-4: Permission to send you marketing information: until you withdraw it.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.5.parrafo-1: We do not sell or share your data. Only the providers we need in order to work have access to it —hosting and email, clinical management software, dental laboratory and advisory services—, all with a signed confidentiality agreement.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.5.parrafo-2: We also share what is strictly necessary with other professionals involved in your case, with your insurer if you have a policy, and with public authorities or the courts when the law requires it.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.5.parrafo-3: The Google and Matterport content shown on the website may involve sending data to the United States, covered by the European Commission's adequacy decision of July 2023 or by standard contractual clauses.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.5.parrafo-4: If you accept measurement cookies, Google Analytics receives data about your browsing (pages viewed, clicks, device and approximate location, with the IP address truncated). We use it only to improve the website, in aggregated reports, and it is kept for 14 months.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.6.parrafo-1: You can ask us to access your data, correct it, erase it, restrict its use, object to it, take it elsewhere or withdraw any permission you have given us.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.6.parrafo-2: Write to us at the email or postal address above, say what you want and attach a copy of your ID document (DNI). We will reply within one month.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.6.parrafo-3: If you think we have not handled it properly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (Agencia Española de Protección de Datos, C/ Jorge Juan 6, 28001 Madrid — www.aepd.es).
legal.politica-de-privacidad.7.parrafo-1: To treat a minor we need the permission of their father, mother or legal guardian. Under the age of fourteen, minors cannot give it themselves.
legal.politica-de-privacidad.7.parrafo-2: We protect your data with technical and organisational measures appropriate to the risk, taking special care with health data. If this policy changes, the valid version is always the one published here, with its date.

ortodoncia.faq.1.respuesta: Custom-made clear trays that correct bite and tooth-position problems. You change them every one or two weeks, depending on your plan.
ortodoncia.faq.2.pregunta: How many hours a day do I need to wear them?
ortodoncia.faq.2.respuesta: Between 21 and 22 hours a day. You only take them out to eat, drink or brush your teeth.
ortodoncia.faq.titulo: The questions we are asked most
ortodoncia.ninos.1.texto: Children aged 3 to 16. Interceptive orthodontics, from 6 months to a year and a half.
ortodoncia.ninos.2.texto: Teenagers aged 16 to 19. Corrective, with wear indicators visible to parents and the orthodontist.
ortodoncia.ninos.boton: Get your case assessed with a photo
ortodoncia.ninos.titulo: There are aligners for younger patients too
ortodoncia.pasos.1.texto: Intraoral and extraoral examination, and your full medical history.
ortodoncia.pasos.2.texto: Intraoral and facial photographs, panoramic X-ray and iTero intraoral scan, with a virtual simulation of your current situation and the final result.
ortodoncia.pasos.3.texto: We plan each movement one by one and send the approved ClinCheck for manufacture. The aligners arrive at the clinic in two to three weeks.
ortodoncia.pasos.4.texto: A dental clean, slight reshaping if needed, and placement of the attachments.
ortodoncia.pasos.5.texto: We fit them for you and explain how to wear them.
ortodoncia.planes.1.puntos.2: Molar-to-molar movements in Class I malocclusions
ortodoncia.planes.1.puntos.3: Maximum of 42 to 75 pairs of aligners
ortodoncia.planes.2.puntos.2: Molar to molar, correcting mild Class II and III malocclusions
ortodoncia.planes.2.puntos.3: Maximum of 60 to 120 pairs of aligners
ortodoncia.planes.3.puntos.1: Corrects all types of malocclusion and moves all the teeth
ortodoncia.planes.3.puntos.2: Treats Class I, II and III
ortodoncia.planes.3.puntos.3: Cases involving extractions and orthognathic surgery, without brackets
ortodoncia.planes.4.puntos.1: Patented technology with separate day and night aligners, which shortens treatment times by up to 40 %
ortodoncia.planes.5.puntos.1: Patented technology for malocclusions that used to require orthognathic surgery
ortodoncia.planes.5.puntos.2: Facial asymmetries, obstructive sleep apnoea and mandibular advancement
ortodoncia.que-es.texto-1: They are custom-made clear trays that correct bite and tooth-position problems. The treatment is planned step by step, so you can see the result before you start.
ortodoncia.que-es.texto-2: Depending on how complex the case is, you change to a new set every one or two weeks and wear them for at least 22 hours a day.
ortodoncia.tecnologia.1.texto: It scans your mouth without moulds and creates a virtual simulation of the starting point and the result.
ortodoncia.tecnologia.2.texto: An app on your phone that monitors your treatment every week and keeps the number of visits to a minimum.
ortodoncia.tecnologia.3.texto: It reduces treatment time by up to 40 %. It is especially suitable for patients with gum (periodontal) problems.
ortodoncia.tecnologia.titulo: What keeps the plan on track
ortodoncia.tipos.enlace: See what the first visit involves
ortodoncia.tipos.nota: Which one is mine? We decide together at the first visit, with the test results in front of us. You don't need to know before you come.
ortodoncia.tipos.texto: Which one is right for you is decided at the first visit, after the examination and tests. You get the price then, in writing.
ortodoncia.tipos.titulo: Five plans, depending on what your case needs
ortodoncia.ventajas.1.texto: Hardly anyone notices you are wearing them.
ortodoncia.ventajas.3.texto: You see the whole plan before you start.
ortodoncia.ventajas.4.texto: You put them in and take them out yourself.
ortodoncia.ventajas.5.texto: Made to the exact shape of your teeth.
ortodoncia.ventajas.7.texto: You brush and floss as usual.
ortodoncia.video.titulo: How to put in your aligner

ortodoncia.visita.2: You fill in the questionnaire and sign it in the waiting room.

tratamientos.cirugia-oral.cruce.texto: If what you want is to straighten your teeth, start here.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.cruce.titulo: Our speciality is still something else
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.entradilla: Straightforward procedures in the mouth, planned calmly and explained before we start.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.que-es-1: It covers the surgical procedures carried out in the mouth: on the gums, the frenula or teeth that need to be removed.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.que-es-2: Sometimes they are a necessary step before orthodontic treatment can work.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.resumen-hub: Gum grafts, frenectomies and wisdom tooth extraction, planned calmly.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.tipos-entradil: We always explain why it is recommended and what to expect afterwards.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.tipos.frenecto: Corrects a frenulum that restricts movement or pushes the teeth apart.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.tipos.injerto-: Replaces gum tissue where it has been lost.
tratamientos.cirugia-oral.tipos.muelas-d: Removal of the third molars when it is indicated.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.cruce.t: The SONRIS GS plan uses aligners to treat malocclusions that used to require orthognathic surgery: asymmetries, apnoea and mandibular advancement.
You may not need an operation
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.entradi: Corrects the jaw bones when the problem is not only the position of the teeth.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.que-es-: It is the surgery that repositions the jaw bones to correct how they relate to each other and to the rest of the face.
It is planned together with orthodontics. Some of these cases can now also be treated with aligners, without an operation.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.resumen: For when the problem is not only the position of the teeth, but the relationship between the jaws.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos-e: Each one is assessed individually; the decision to operate is never made from a website.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos.a: Cases where the airway narrows during sleep.
Differences between the two sides of the face.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos.m: Correction of the projection or shape of the chin.
The teeth do not meet when you close your mouth.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos.p: Lower jaw positioned forward of the upper jaw.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos.r: Lower jaw set back from its normal position.
tratamientos.cirugia-ortognatica.tipos.s: Too much gum showing when you smile.
tratamientos.endodoncia.cruce.texto: If what you want is to straighten your teeth, start here.
tratamientos.endodoncia.cruce.titulo: Our speciality is still something else
tratamientos.endodoncia.entradilla: When the inside of a tooth is damaged, we treat it from within to save it.
tratamientos.endodoncia.que-es-1: It involves removing the damaged tissue from inside the tooth, cleaning the canals and sealing them. This keeps the tooth in your mouth.
tratamientos.endodoncia.que-es-2: It is classified by the number of roots that need treating.
tratamientos.endodoncia.que-es-titulo: What is a root canal treatment?
tratamientos.endodoncia.resumen-hub: We treat the inside of the tooth, clean the canals and seal them to keep it in your mouth.
tratamientos.endodoncia.tipos-entradilla: The type depends on the anatomy of the affected tooth, not on how bad the pain is.
tratamientos.endodoncia.tipos.multirradi: Teeth with three or more roots, usually molars.
tratamientos.endodoncia.tipos.unirradicu: Teeth with a single root and one canal to treat.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.cruce.texto: Whitening and veneers are considered once the teeth are where they should be.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.entradilla: Once your teeth are in place, we work on colour and shape.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.que-es-1: It is the set of treatments that improve how your teeth look without changing how they work: colour, shape and proportions.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.que-es-2: At Sonris we always plan it after orthodontics, not instead of it: first the position, then the finish.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.resumen-hub: Once your teeth are in place, we work on colour and shape: whitening and veneers.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.tipos.blanq: Lightens the shade of your teeth without removing tooth structure.
tratamientos.estetica-dental.tipos.caril: Thin shells bonded to the visible surface of the tooth to correct shape and colour.
tratamientos.faq.1.pregunta: Is the first visit also FREE for these treatments?
tratamientos.faq.1.respuesta: Yes. The first visit is FREE and with no obligation, whatever treatment you come in for. We examine you, assess your case and give you a plan.
tratamientos.faq.2.respuesta: We are open Monday to Friday, from 12:00 to 20:00. We are closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
tratamientos.hero.texto: Our speciality is invisible orthodontics, and around it we treat whatever is needed for the treatment to go well. Open each one to see how we work.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.cruce.te: Replacing the missing tooth is usually the step before treatment with aligners.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.cruce.ti: First the gap, then the movement
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.entradil: When a tooth is missing, we replace it with an artificial root that integrates with the bone.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.que-es-1: It is a titanium screw that replaces the root of the lost tooth. The bone integrates it through osseointegration, and the crown is placed on top.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.que-es-2: Replacing the missing tooth is usually the step before moving the rest: without it, the neighbouring teeth drift into the gap.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.resumen-: We replace the missing tooth with a titanium root that the bone integrates, before moving the rest.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.tipos-en: Which one is right depends on the available bone and your case; it is decided with the test results in front of us.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.tipos.al: Four implants support a full arch. Indicated when all or nearly all teeth are missing.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.tipos.ca: The temporary crown is fitted in the same procedure as the implant, when conditions allow.
tratamientos.implantes-dentales.tipos.ti: The material is titanium, which is biocompatible. Osseointegration is the process by which the bone bonds to the implant.
tratamientos.indicaciones.texto-1: Already had treatment with us? See the
tratamientos.indicaciones.texto-2: for the days after the procedure.
tratamientos.odontologia-general.cruce.t: If what you want is to straighten your teeth, start here.
Our speciality is still something else
tratamientos.odontologia-general.entradi: The usual check-ups and repairs, in the same clinic where you straighten your teeth.
tratamientos.odontologia-general.que-es-: It is the basic care: checking, preventing and solving the most common problems before they get worse.
A healthy mouth is the starting point for any orthodontic treatment.
tratamientos.odontologia-general.resumen: The usual check-ups and repairs, in the same clinic where you straighten your teeth.
tratamientos.odontologia-general.tipos-e: The two repairs that come up most at a check-up: one restores the tooth from the outside, the other treats it from within.
tratamientos.odontologia-general.tipos.e: Restore the part of the tooth affected by decay.
Treatment of the inside of the tooth to avoid extracting it.
tratamientos.periodoncia.cruce.texto: If there is gingivitis or periodontitis, it is treated first: orthodontics waits until the foundation is healthy.
tratamientos.periodoncia.entradilla: The gum is the foundation everything moves on. If it is not healthy, orthodontics waits.
tratamientos.periodoncia.que-es-1: It is the branch of dentistry that deals with the gums and the bone that holds the teeth in place.
tratamientos.periodoncia.que-es-2: It distinguishes two diseases: one reversible and one that can only be controlled.
tratamientos.periodoncia.resumen-hub: The gum is the foundation everything moves on. If it is not healthy, orthodontics waits.
tratamientos.periodoncia.tipos-entradill: Diagnosis is made in the clinic, with probing and X-rays.
tratamientos.periodoncia.tipos.gingiviti: Inflammation of the gum. It is reversible: treated in time, the gum returns to its normal state.
tratamientos.periodoncia.tipos.periodont: The inflammation also affects the bone. It is not reversible, but it can be controlled with treatment and follow-up.
